inputs.inputs.text1: [quietly, close to the mic] I ran the numbers twice... the engine is holding steady. Wait, why is the alarm light-
inputs.inputs.text2: [jumping in] -because I already started it. [laughs] You were taking too long. [deadpan] We have forty seconds.
inputs.inputs.text3: [sighs, then firmly] Then stop smiling and seal the hatch. [urgent] I need the console live before the countdown hits twenty.
inputs.inputs.text4: [amused] Already sealed. [quickly] The console is yours... and there goes the countdown.
